text:
Get model answers without giving callers the provider key. Ask a question or request a structured decision. Send ask with a prompt, or decide with a decision request.
ask <prompt...>: Get a model answer. Send prompt text for a text reply, or an OpenAI chat request for the provider response as JSON.
  prompt (json): Prompt text, or an OpenAI chat-completions object in JSON; text returns assistant text, an object returns provider JSON
decide <body...>: Get answers to typed decision questions. Send an OpenRouter Decisions request; the reply is the full provider response as JSON.
  body (string): Raw JSON request, including state, questions and the decision model; sent unchanged

model.help: Default chat model ID for ask/text and chat JSON requests without model; not injected into decide

base_url.help: Trusted OpenAI-compatible API root; chat/completions is appended for ask, decide uses the same origin at /api/alpha/decisions

secrets.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
secrets.help: Provider API key, required. Set only in runner/ai/env on the host, never bus Secret or Configuration.
